{{Quote|Mendu&hellip;''Zovius'' Mendu? Master Feln tried to catch him last month. Disappeared, or something.|Zayne Carrick|<ref name="kotor3" />}}
'''Zovius Mendu''' was an infamous criminal on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the era of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. By [[3964 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] had built enough of a reputation to have the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Feln]] personally hunting him. Keen to find a way off Taris, Mendu enlisted local hood [[Marn Hierogryph]] to help him escape the planet&mdash;Hierogryph arranged to have Mendu shipped to the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in an old [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] disguised to look like a crate of dried [[dreeka]] [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. The plan was a success, and Mendu was thought to have disappeared.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Or something. I shipped him to Corellia as a crate of dried ''dreeka fish''!|Marn Hierogryph, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="kotor3" />}}
A well-known criminal and ne'er-do-well,<ref name="handbook">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> Zovius Mendu was a wanted<ref name="prime">{{KOTORbackups|0}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|man]]<ref name="kotor3" /> with a sizable [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head<ref name="adjudicator">{{KOTORbackups|14}}</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] by [[3964 BBY]]. Mendu had a patrol actively searching for him, with no success&mdash;eventually they had to redouble their hunt, an event reported upon by the ''[[Taris Holofeed]]''.<ref name="prime" /> In addition, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Feln]] of the Tarisian [[Jedi Tower]] took the search for Mendu into his own hands. Needing a way off Taris, Mendu enlisted the help of local hood [[Marn Hierogryph]], who worked up an escape plan. Hierogryph hired [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Gorman Vandrayk|Gorman "Camper" Vandrayk]] to refit an old [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] into a shipping container. Disguised as a crate of dried [[dreeka]] [[Fish/Legends|fish]], Mendu hid inside the container, which Hierogryph shipped to the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Hierogryph's plan was a complete success&mdash;a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later, former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], who was acquainted with Feln, remarked that Mendu had mysteriously disappeared.<ref name="kotor3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although he has never directly appeared in any ''[[Star Wars]]'' work thus far, the character of Zovius Mendu has been mentioned several times, first in ''[[The Taris Holofeed: Prime Edition]]'', an [[in-universe]] news report that appears on the last page of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 0|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 0]].<ref name="prime" /> Mendu is also mentioned in another such news report, ''[[The Adjudicator Special Report: The Outer Rim]]'',<ref name="adjudicator" /> along with the [[Knights of the Old Republic 3|third issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]]<ref name="kotor3" /> and the ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''.<ref name="handbook" />
